description: Read any online store's product page as clean data: name, brand, price, currency, stock, rating, images and SKU. Works best on brand and Shopify stores. Use it when: You have a product link from a brand's own store and need its price, stock and details as data, for a comparison, a catalog or a price check. Not for: Amazon or eBay (use the amazon and ebay-sold-prices nodes), and big retailers that block automated visits; those return no product and are not charged. Returns: Name, brand, SKU, GTIN, description, price and high price, currency, availability, variant count, rating, images and URL. Typical time: about 3 s. Price: $0.003 per page, charged only on success. One call = one product page as data.
name: product-page
title: Product page to structured data
